subject: Implement cross-session continuity injection for Johnny
description:
Implement "Previously on..." context injection for session continuity in Agent Hub.

**Project:** Agent Hub (~/agent-hub/)

**Skills:** Use `/async-python-patterns` for async patterns.

**Scope:**
- Create continuity injector service
- Generate "Previously worked on" context block
- Track project-session relationships
- Find related sessions by content similarity
- Inject continuity context at session start

**Continuity Block Format:**
```
## Recent Activity
### Yesterday
- Implemented user auth: Added JWT tokens
- Fixed login bug: Rate limiting issue

### 2 days ago
- Refactored API: Consolidated endpoints
```

**Files:**
- ~/agent-hub/backend/app/services/johnny/continuity_injector.py (new)
- ~/agent-hub/backend/app/services/johnny/context_injector.py (integrate)
- Update session start flow to inject continuity

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] ContinuityInjector service created
- [ ] "Previously on" context generated
- [ ] Project-session relationships tracked
- [ ] Related sessions found by similarity
- [ ] Continuity injected at session start
- [ ] Context appears in agent prompts
- [ ] `dt --check` passes
- [ ] `rebuild.sh --backend` completed (in agent-hub)

**Context Check:** If >= 60%, /compact first. If >= 75%, /commit_it then /compact.

**Completion:** Run /commit_it after verification passes.
